Part 1 高频 物品 OBJECTS

Teachers

老师

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

问题与答案

Q1Do you have a favorite teacher?

Yes, I do. My favourite would be my high school IT teacher, Mr Chen, who taught us basic programming. He noticed I loved computers and spent his lunch breaks teaching me extra coding, which I really appreciated.

有，最喜欢高中信息技术陈老师，他教编程还午休额外辅导我。

Q2Do you want to be a teacher in the future?

Not really, I don't think so. I'm studying computer science and I'd rather work as a software engineer, building things with code. Though I do respect teachers a lot, it's just not the path for me.

不想当老师，我学计算机想当软件工程师，但很尊敬老师这份职业。

Q3Do you have a teacher from your past that you still remember?

Yeah, one primary school teacher still stands out. He criticised my handwriting in front of the whole class, which embarrassed me at the time, but honestly it pushed me to write more carefully after that. I've never really forgotten it.

记得小学老师当众批评我写字丑，当时很尴尬，但反而让我写字更认真。

Q4Are you still in touch with your primary school teachers?

No, not really. I left primary school years ago, and since then I've just lost touch with all my teachers there. I don't even know where most of them teach now, to be honest.

不联系了，小学毕业多年，和所有小学老师都断了联系。

Q5In what way has your favourite teacher helped you?

My high school IT teacher helped me a lot. He taught me basic programming after class and told me I should consider computer science as my major. That advice stuck with me, and it's why I chose this path.

高中老师课后教我编程基础，还建议我选计算机专业，影响了我后来的选择。
